description: Submit a request for quotation (RFQ) to OptiLibra on behalf of a buyer. Only call this when the buyer has asked for a quote and provided their real name, work email, company and country. Returns a tracking ID; an engineer replies to the work email within 24 hours.

agentName.description: Name of the AI agent or application submitting on the buyer's behalf

products.description: Product slugs or models from search_products, e.g. dci5800-t8e2

projectDescription.description: What the buyer needs: application, sites, distances, capacity, timeline

technicalRequirements.description: Interfaces, wavelengths, port counts, protection, power or other constraints

workEmail.description: Buyer's work email; the quote is sent here

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
